newsitem.title: USA: MobileMedia gets remainder of DIP funds.
newsitem.headline: MobileMedia gets remainder of DIP funds.

text.p: MobileMedia Corp said on Monday it has gained access to the remaining $100 million of debtor-in-possession (DIP) financing provided by its post-petition bank group.

As previously announced, MobileMedia had entered into an agreement providing for a total of $200 million of DIP financing from a consortium of banks led by The Chase Manhattan Bank and had received access to $100 million.

One of the conditions to receiving the remaining $100 million was that the company deliver a business plan by April 15, 1997 that would be found satisfactory by the banks' financial advisor, the company said.
MobileMedia also said earlier today that a judge denied a stay of Federal Communications Commission hearings about allegations that the company misrepresented the status of its paging stations.
The Company said it would use the DIP financing to fund normal business operations and other cash needs.
